purpose: CPU feasibility variant registered before scoring any task in the fixed 100-task cohort

condition.A: zero-shot output from same checkpoint at image_size 32
condition.D: task-specific TTT from same checkpoint/random-token reset per task; image_size 32
condition.positional_embedding: bicubic interpolation from checkpoint image_size 64; all other loaded weights unchanged
condition.candidate_policy: one zero-shot output plus up to two distinct translated post-TTT predictions; duplicate grids count once

analysis_lock: Do not read training solutions or score either A/D32 or A/D64 for this cohort until both 32px and 64px predictions for all 100 tasks are complete; scorer remains a separate process.
